selection_record_note: no Stage 9A scorecard -- this is an engine-feasibility check, not a candidate; see protocol section 1-2
canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

universe_construction.source: backend/app/universe.py:build_universe (S&P 500 union Nasdaq-100 union 11 XL sector ETFs)

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 open/high/low/close doubles + signed 64-bit integer volume
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time
data.common_date_alignment: true set-intersection of each symbols stored trading dates within [cutoff_date, common_end], not a min/max date-range filter

scope_decision: Reuses backend/app/research.py:etf12_rotation_bootstrap unmodified -- already asset-count-agnostic. No new statistical machinery. No cluster/sector breadth gate (no equity sector classification exists in this codebase); see protocol section 3.

formation.definition: F(t) = close(t)/close(t-126) - 1, per asset, computed through close t only
formation.rationale: Jegadeesh and Titman (1993) classic 6-month formation horizon for individual equities, deliberately different from ETF-12 rotations 60-session rotation-cadence-tuned window -- see protocol section 1 (disclosed pre-lock peek) for why this must not simply copy ETF-12s parameters

holding.rationale: classic 1-month forward return paired with 6-month formation

rebalance_grid.definition: rebalance dates at session indices 126, 147, 168, ... through the last index with a full forward window available

rank.tie_breaking: average rank (ties split the contested rank positions evenly)

estimand.statistic: pooled Spearman rank correlation between formation rank and forward rank, across all (asset, rebalance date) pairs
estimand.evidential_status: non-evidential -- reported for transparency only; see protocol section 1 and 6

bootstrap.base_function: backend/app/research.py:etf12_rotation_bootstrap (joint-panel block-resampling extension, unmodified from ETF-12 rotation)
bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled pooled correlation >= observed, plus add-one correction
bootstrap.joint_resampling: the same resampled date-block sequence is applied to all assets simultaneously in each resample, preserving real contemporaneous cross-asset correlation while breaking the specific formation-to-forward temporal link
bootstrap.no_holm_correction: single pooled statistic across the whole panel, not per-asset tests; Holm correction does not apply
bootstrap.pre_lock_timing_probe: resamples=20 at the module default formation=60/holding=20 was run before locking to estimate runtime feasibility at this panel size; the observed correlation from that probe was not recorded and did not influence any parameter below -- disclosed in full in protocol section 1

gates.reproducibility: byte-identical correlation/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

multiplicity.parameter_grid: none in this run; one locked formation window and holding horizon

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this feasibility check
scope_exclusions.no_sector_breadth_gate: no equity sector/industry classification exists in this codebase -- see protocol section 3
scope_exclusions.no_confirmatory_claim: survivorship-biased universe and a disclosed pre-lock parameter peek both independently rule out confirmatory status -- see protocol section 1
scope_exclusions.no_sleeve_or_executable_expression: not applicable -- this is not a candidate
